independence_evidence: The about page states that the Watershed Sentinel Educational Society, a non-profit, is the publisher, and the store page says the magazine is 'free from corporate sponsorship' and funded by subscribers, patrons and donors (https://watershedsentinel.ca/about/, https://watershedsentinel.ca/store/).
qualifies_reason: A non-profit, independently published print environmental magazine that has issued five print editions a year through 2025 and 2026, the latest being the December 2026 | January 2027 issue.
what_it_is: Watershed Sentinel is an environmental news magazine from Vancouver Island covering water, forests, energy projects, climate, food systems, Indigenous rights and conservation in British Columbia and western Canada. Each themed issue gathers reporting, analysis and opinion from grassroots campaigners, scientists and community writers, and comes with a PDF edition. It is for readers who follow regional environmental politics and activism rather than general nature writing.
